sections.body: Ansor reports gains across single operators, subgraphs, end-to-end DNNs, hardware backends, and search-time comparisons, making performance evaluation part of the optimization story rather than an afterthought.
sections.heading: Ansor's evaluation scope

sections.body: Aestimo shows why this matters: feedback-directed optimization outcomes can change materially with training and evaluation inputs, single-input evaluation can be unreliable, and workload-wide runtime summaries provide stronger evidence.
sections.heading: Input sensitivity in feedback-directed optimization

sections.body: Related sources add complementary angles: profile-guided classic optimization separates profiling and measurement inputs, while machine-learning compilation depends on representative training data and feature quality.
sections.heading: Shared evaluation lesson
